title: Foundry market statistics methodology: how TrendForce, Counterpoint, TechInsights, Gartner and IDC define and compute foundry revenue (scope, captive IDM revenue, group consolidation, FX, calendarisation)
why_it_matters: Foundry share and size figures differ by up to 2x and Samsung's share moved from 17.8% to ~6% partly through scope changes; users need a register of each series' population before comparing them.
questions: Which companies does each firm include, and how are Samsung System LSI, Intel Foundry internal revenue and PSMC memory treated?
Which exchange rates and calendarisation do they apply?
How have definitions changed over time (e.g. TrendForce Samsung scope change c.2020-2023)?
Does any firm publish a whole-market (not top-10) total and a node-band split?
